quote: One of the theorems proved by Ramsey in his 1928 paper On a Problem of Formal Logic now bears his name (Ramsey's theorem).
note: Ramsey proved what is now known as Ramsey's theorem as a lemma in this foundational 1928 paper. The specific study of Ramsey numbers R(m,n) and the question of their values, particularly R(5,5), developed later as the field of Ramsey Theory was expanded by Erdős and others.
